thread:
Elena: Thanks everyone for the questions during the all-hands — wanted to open a follow-up thread for the customer wins/losses section so leadership can capture concrete asks and next steps.
Marco: Quick recap — top two loss themes we highlighted were: integrations complexity and pricing predictability. Top wins: latency guarantees for Dedicated and a clear SLAs narrative.
Priya: For the lost deals, customers kept pointing to onboarding time for Private. They want a 'deploy checklist' and a faster validation path (network + KMS).
Jun: Noted. We should add a templated Nginx + VPC example and a KMS quickstart. I can draft and ping docs.
Sam: Are we tracking how often we lose because of inference cost vs model quality? Curious if cost is the dominant factor for mid-market.
Priya: In mid-market, cost is often the gating factor; for enterprise it's security/SLA. We saw 3 deals last quarter where unit cost was the blocker even though quality was fine.
Ava: Can we get a short one-pager that maps "ask -> owner -> expected ETA" so CS can hand it to prospects?
Elena: Good ask. Owner + ETA one-pager makes sense. Marco, can you coordinate with Product + Docs?
Marco: Yep. I'll own the one-pager. Tentative ETA: two weeks. Will include: Dedicated SLAs summary, Private quickstart links, typical cost-saving knobs (batching, quantization), and common rebuttals.
Priya: Also add a short case study/example showing a customer who moved from hosted to Dedicated and cut per-token costs ~40%. That helps sales talk track.
Jun: I can get a sanitized example from the onboarding tracking sheet.
Sam: On the roadmap side, any clarity on prioritizing "private onboarding scripts" vs "console guided deploy"? Customers asked for both.
Marco: We're splitting effort: immediate short-term = scripts and templates (2-week spike), medium = Console guided flow (Q2).
Ava: For feedback loops: can we add a "lost-deal" tag in CRM that auto-triggers a quick internal postmortem (1–pager) and routes to product weekly reviews?
Priya: Yes, we already have a CRM tag; need to hook it to an automated workflow. Sarah from Rev Ops volunteered last week.
Elena: Great. Action items: Marco to draft one-pager (2w), Jun to provide sanitized case study (1w), Docs to add Private quickstart (owner TBD, 2w), Rev Ops to wire CRM -> product postmortem (owner: Sarah). I'll follow up in next all-hands.
Sam: tiny ask — can we include "expected perf numbers" (p50/p95 latency) on the one-pager so sales can set expectations?
Marco: Yes — will include per-model p50/p95 ranges and common batch settings.
Ava: If docs or one-pager needs reviews from GTM, tag us early. We can run a rapid take in 24–48h.
Priya: Thanks — that turnaround helps.
Elena: Anything else from leadership side before we close?
Sam: One more — could we surface a short checklist for evaluating "model variant tradeoffs" (e.g., cheaper quantized variant vs baseline quality) so CS can advise customers?
Jun: Good idea — I'll add a 3-item decision checklist to the one-pager: latency target, quality tolerance, cost ceiling.
Ava: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: created task #4572 "All-hands customer one-pager" and assigned to Marco. Due 2026-04-06.
Elena: Thanks everyone. I'll mark this thread as the canonical follow-up and we'll include progress updates in next all-hands notes.
